findings.detail: The GME Supply senior secured term loan appears to have the acquisition date 2023-06-30 treated as maturity, while the source maturity date is 2027-07-05.

rationale: The raw schedule header places Acquisition Date before Maturity Date. In table 21 row 16, GME Supply's 6/30/2023 value is in the Acquisition Date column and the same source row reports Maturity Date 7/5/2027. A maturity_not_past fire at report date 2023-06-30 is therefore a real extraction error caused by using the acquisition date as maturity.
